title: General Utilities Module
summary: This module provides a collection of general-purpose utility functions, including system information display, data stream manipulation, HTML parsing, Pydantic model helpers, serialization/deserialization, and version consistency checks. It supports various foundational operations across the LangChain ecosystem.

nodes.label: Print System Info
nodes.title: Display System and Package Information
nodes.description: Gathers and prints detailed information about the operating system, Python version, and installed LangChain-related packages for debugging and environment analysis.

nodes.label: Split Async Stream
nodes.title: Split Async Iterable into Multiple Streams
nodes.description: Creates 'n' independent asynchronous iterators from a single async iterable, allowing multiple consumers to process the same data stream concurrently or sequentially.

nodes.label: Extract HTML Links
nodes.title: Parse HTML and Extract Absolute Links
nodes.description: Analyzes raw HTML content to find all embedded links, converts them to absolute URLs, and provides options to filter by base URL, regex patterns, and exclude prefixes.

nodes.label: Split Sync Stream
nodes.title: Split Iterable into Multiple Streams
nodes.description: Creates 'n' independent synchronous iterators from a single iterable, enabling multiple consumers to process the same data stream.

nodes.label: Pydantic Model Init Wrapper
nodes.title: Decorator for Pydantic Model Initialization
nodes.description: A decorator that modifies Pydantic model initialization to handle default values and populate fields by alias, ensuring consistent data handling.

nodes.label: Get Pydantic Version
nodes.title: Retrieve Pydantic Major Version
nodes.description: Returns the major version number of the installed Pydantic library. This function is deprecated in favor of direct `PYDANTIC_VERSION.major` access.

nodes.label: Exclusive Arg Validator
nodes.title: Decorator for Exclusive Argument Validation
nodes.description: A decorator that ensures exactly one argument within specified groups is provided and not None, raising a ValueError if validation fails.

nodes.label: Validate Core Version
nodes.title: Validate LangChain Core Version Consistency
nodes.description: Compares the version specified in `pyproject.toml` with the version defined in `langchain_core/version.py` to ensure consistency for the core library.

nodes.label: Dynamic Module Importer
nodes.title: Import Modules by Name with Deprecation Handling
nodes.description: Dynamically imports modules and their components by name, providing deprecation warnings for older import paths and handling module not found errors.

nodes.label: Initialize Embeddings
nodes.title: Create an Embedding Model Instance
nodes.description: Initializes an embedding model from a given model name and optional provider, abstracting away the specific integration package details.

nodes.label: Validate LangChain v1 Version
nodes.title: Validate LangChain v1 Version Consistency
nodes.description: Compares the version specified in `pyproject.toml` with the version defined in `langchain/__init__.py` for the LangChain v1 library.

nodes.label: Refresh Model Profiles
nodes.title: CLI for Model Profile Data Management
nodes.description: Provides a command-line interface to download and merge model profile data for a specified provider from `models.dev`.

nodes.label: Validate Anthropic Version
nodes.title: Validate Anthropic Integration Version Consistency
nodes.description: Compares the version specified in `pyproject.toml` with the version defined in `langchain_anthropic/_version.py` for the Anthropic integration.

nodes.label: Serialize Embedding
nodes.title: Convert Embedding Vector to Bytes
nodes.description: Serializes a list of floating-point numbers (an embedding vector) into a JSON string, then encodes it as bytes for storage or transmission.

nodes.label: Deserialize Embedding
nodes.title: Convert Bytes to Embedding Vector
nodes.description: Decodes a byte string (expected to be JSON) into a list of floating-point numbers, reconstructing an embedding vector.

nodes.label: Dump Serializable
nodes.title: Serialize Serializable Object to Bytes
nodes.description: Converts any `Serializable` object into a byte representation using JSON serialization, suitable for storage.

nodes.label: Dump Document
nodes.title: Serialize Document Object to Bytes
nodes.description: Converts a `Document` object into a byte representation using JSON serialization, ensuring it's a valid Document instance.

nodes.label: Load Document
nodes.title: Deserialize Bytes to Document Object
nodes.description: Reconstructs a `Document` object from its byte representation, validating that the deserialized object is indeed a Document.

nodes.label: Load Serializable
nodes.title: Deserialize Bytes to Serializable Object
nodes.description: Reconstructs a `Serializable` object from its byte representation. Note: This process can be unsafe with untrusted input.

nodes.label: pyproject.toml
nodes.title: Project Configuration File
nodes.description: Standard configuration file for Python projects, containing metadata and dependencies.

nodes.label: Version Files
nodes.title: Package Version Definition Files
nodes.description: Python files (e.g., `version.py`, `__init__.py`) that define the version string for a package.

nodes.label: models.dev API
nodes.title: External Model Profile Data Source
nodes.description: An external API providing structured data about various language models and their profiles.

nodes.label: Embedding Providers
nodes.title: External Embedding Services
nodes.description: Various external services (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace) that generate vector embeddings for text.

nodes.label: Other Python Modules
nodes.title: Dynamically Loadable Modules
nodes.description: Other Python packages or modules that can be imported at runtime by name.

nodes.label: Raw HTML Content
nodes.title: Input HTML String
nodes.description: An unstructured string containing HTML markup.

nodes.label: Data Stream
nodes.title: Generic Data Sequence
nodes.description: A sequence of data items, which can be synchronous (iterable) or asynchronous (async iterable).

nodes.label: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.title: Pydantic Data Model
nodes.description: A class inheriting from Pydantic's BaseModel, used for data validation and settings management.

nodes.label: Embedding Vector
nodes.title: Numerical Embedding Representation
nodes.description: A list of floating-point numbers representing a text embedding.

nodes.label: Byte Data
nodes.title: Binary Data Representation
nodes.description: Binary data (bytes) used for storage or transmission of serialized objects.

nodes.label: Serializable Object
nodes.title: Object Implementing Serializable
nodes.description: An object that adheres to the `Serializable` interface, allowing it to be converted to and from a byte representation.

nodes.label: Document Object
nodes.title: LangChain Document Instance
nodes.description: A specific LangChain `Document` object, typically containing page content and metadata.

groups.label: System & CLI Tools
groups.title: System Information and Command-Line Utilities
groups.description: Functions for retrieving system information, validating package versions, and managing model profiles via command-line interfaces.

groups.label: Data Flow & Iteration
groups.title: Utilities for Data Stream Management
groups.description: Tools for splitting single data streams (both synchronous and asynchronous) into multiple independent iterators for concurrent or sequential processing.

groups.label: Web Content Processing
groups.title: HTML Parsing and Link Extraction
groups.description: Functionality to parse HTML content, extract embedded links, and normalize them into absolute URLs with various filtering options.

groups.label: Pydantic Model Helpers
groups.title: Utilities for Pydantic Data Models
groups.description: Functions and decorators to assist with Pydantic model initialization, field population, and version checking.

groups.label: Serialization & Storage
groups.title: Object to Byte Conversion for Storage
groups.description: Utilities for converting various LangChain objects (embeddings, `Serializable`, `Document`) to and from byte representations for persistence or transmission.

groups.label: Core Utilities & Integrations
groups.title: General-Purpose Helpers and Integration Initializers
groups.description: Includes decorators for argument validation, dynamic module loading, and simplified initialization of embedding models from various providers.
